summary: Studio City International Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited second quarter 2026 earnings results. The filing reports total operating revenues of US$164.6 million, down from US$190.1 million in the prior year, with a net loss attributable to the company of US$15.6 million. Adjusted EBITDA was US$67.0 million. The results reflect softer mass market table games performance and lower non-gaming revenues. This is a routine earnings announcement with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic actions. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are disclosed.
